P7568.corridor_notes: 855km (sheet) / 863.06km (EIA cumulative mileage) Tongliang-Qianjiang trunk, the Phase 2 (二阶段) trunk of the 川气东送二线天然气管道工程川渝鄂段 (Sichuan-Shanghai Parallel Gas Pipeline, Sichuan-Chongqing-Hubei section). Runs from the Tongliang/Hechuan district boundary (Chongqing) through numbered valve chambers 9# (北碚区澄江镇) - 10# (合川区草街镇) - 11# (北碚区柳荫镇) - 12# (渝北区大湾镇) - 大盛站(渝北区统景镇) - 14# (长寿区葛兰镇) - 16# (垫江县砚台镇) - ...on through further Chongqing/Hubei counties (忠县, 云阳, etc. per the same table, not individually resourced here) - to the Qianjiang Distribution Compressor Station in Hubei. GEM's Status='construction' is consistent with this being the currently-building Phase 2 trunk (vs. the completed Phase 1 Weiyuan/Luxian-Tongliang segment and the still-public-comment-stage Phase 3 supply branches). This trunk is what my 7 sibling PIDs (P7581-P7587, Phase 3 local supply branches) tap off of.
P7568.researcher_notes: Both master EIA PDFs (环境影响报告书, not just the brief 批复 approval notices) for the 川渝鄂段 project are hosted on archive.org with full OCR text: Phase 1 (Weiyuan/Luxian-Tongliang trunk) at 034f-60b-7539c-46b-78f-68bcdf-4feb-9975, Phase 2 (this PID's trunk, Tongliang-Qianjiang, + the 4 major storage-facility branches) at 759f-1a-193815494692b-2742c-895d-53a-7. Both already existed as GEM's 'current_route_ref' in worklist.json but were unused before this research pass -- confirmed high-value primary sources, reused across all 8 of my PIDs. Table 2.2-22 in the Phase 2 doc is the authoritative valve-chamber/township location table for this trunk and is the anchor for locating 5 of my 7 branch PIDs' start points (12#, 9#, 16# directly; DAT4# and 6# via a separate sub-branch table / the Phase 1 doc respectively). ResearcherNotes on this row (and the 7 branch rows) says 'MZ: ...（二阶段）' -- based on the EIA's own phase breakdown (line ~2898-2905 of the OCR text, '二阶段建设铜梁-潜江段干线、和牢家坪老翁场储气库支干线、大英-安岳-铜梁支干线、铜锣峡储气库支干线、黄草峡储气库支干线；三阶段建设...供气支线'), THIS trunk (P7568) genuinely is Phase 2 scope, matching the MZ note -- but the 7 short branch PIDs (P7581-P7587) are Phase 3 (三阶段) '供气支线' scope, so the shared '二阶段' ResearcherNotes label on those 7 rows appears to be an imprecise carryover, not accurate to this EIA's own phase definitions. Documented here rather than corrected on the sheet.

P7644.corridor_notes: 文23-安庆天然气管道项目 (Wen23 gas storage-Anqing gas pipeline project), built/owned by 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司西气东输分公司 (PipeChina West-East Gas Pipeline Branch). Per PipeChina's own Dec-2024 EIA public-participation notice: the whole project comprises 濮阳-亳州段 (Puyang-Bozhou, ~375.1km, = P7645), 亳州-淮南段 (Bozhou-Huainan, ~210.8km, = P7646), 淮南-安庆段 (Huainan-Anqing, ~265km, = P7647), plus two minor connectors not separately tracked as their own GEM rows: 濮阳联络站-鄂安沧管道连接线 (Puyang liaison station-E'anCang pipeline connector, 1.8km, co-trenched with the Wen23-storage-to-Puyang-liaison-station segment) and a 0.3km local reroute of the existing 西二线平泰支干线 at 菏泽分输清管站 (Heze, Shandong) so that line passes through a newly built 菏泽联络压气站. Total NEW pipe = 642.2km (=375.1+265+1.8+0.3; the 210.8km Bozhou-Huainan stretch is explicitly EXCLUDED from the new-build total because it reuses an existing/parallel corridor rather than laying new pipe there — see P7646 notes). The whole line starts at the existing Wen23 underground gas storage (converted from the depleted Wen23 gas field, in 中原油田/Zhongyuan Oilfield territory, Puyang, Henan) and ends at Anqing Liaison Station, Anhui, crossing Henan, Shandong (via the Heze reroute) and Anhui.
P7644.researcher_notes: P7644 is the parent/whole-line row; its route is the concatenation of P7645 (Puyang-Bozhou) + P7646 (Bozhou-Huainan) + P7647 (Huainan-Anqing), plus two minor sub-1.8km connectors PipeChina's notice lists but that do not appear to have their own GEM rows (a Puyang-liaison-station-to-鄂安沧-pipeline tie-in, and a 0.3km reroute of an unrelated existing line — 西二线平泰支干线 — near Heze, Shandong, to accommodate a new Heze liaison compressor station). Not a duplicate of the segment rows (different granularity — whole line vs. sub-segments), so duplicate_of is left null per instructions. GEM's LengthMergedKm (643.20) is close to but not identical to PipeChina's official total (642.2km, or 852.7km if you sum all three named segments without excluding the reused Bozhou-Huainan stretch) — a ~1km rounding/version difference, not flagged as material. P7646.corridor_notes: 亳州-淮南段 of the 文23-安庆天然气管道项目, ~210.8km, DN1016mm. Per PipeChina's Dec-2024 EIA notice, this segment does NOT get its own new pipe: '路由与川气东送二线天然气管道工程皖西支干线（预计2026年建成投产）高度重合，为避免重复建设，考虑此段路由依托皖西支干线。本项目对皖西支干线的阜阳分输清管站进行改扩建' (the route is highly coincident with the 皖西支干线/Anhui West branch of the separate 川气东送二线 project, expected online 2026; to avoid duplicate construction, this segment relies on/reuses the Anhui West branch's corridor; this project's own scope here is limited to renovating/expanding the Fuyang Distribution & Pigging Station — 阜阳分输清管站 — on that branch line). This is confirmed by two other PipeChina EIA notices for 川气东送二线天然气管道工程鄂豫赣皖浙闽段项目: the Oct-2024 notice for the main trunk + several liaison lines (not this branch), and a May-2025 pre-approval notice specifically for '(皖西支干线、皖赣支干线)' (Anhui-West branch + Anhui-Jiangxi branch) confirming 皖西支干线 as a real, separately-EIA'd PipeChina project crossing Hubei/Henan/Anhui/Zhejiang/Fujian as part of the broader 川气东送二线 corridor. GEM's own P7613 ('Huainan-Bozhou Branch Line', 川气东送二线, 208.4km, Anhui-Anhui) is almost certainly this same 皖西支干线, run in the reverse direction (Huainan→Bozhou vs. this row's Bozhou→Huainan) — see duplicate/flag note below. Neither the exact route of 皖西支干线 nor the Fuyang station's precise coordinates were locatable in available sources; 阜阳市 (Fuyang, Anhui) sits roughly midway on the Bozhou-Huainan line and is the most likely intermediate waypoint.
P7646.researcher_notes: Matches the existing GEM ResearcherNotes on this row almost verbatim (both trace to the same PipeChina EIA notice), so treat this as strong corroboration of an already-correct note rather than a new finding. FLAG (not set as duplicate_of, per instructions): this segment's route is explicitly stated to physically reuse the 川气东送二线 皖西支干线 corridor rather than laying new pipe — i.e., for GIS/route-drawing purposes, P7646's candidate geometry should likely BE (or very closely follow) P7613's geometry once that is drawn/sourced, just traversed in the opposite direction. Recommend the human reviewer check whether P7613 already has (or will get) a routes-repo geometry before independently drawing P7646, to avoid two near-identical but not-quite-matching traces for what is functionally one physical corridor. Endpoints given here are the same city-level approximations as P7645 (Bozhou) and P7647 (Huainan) start, for consistency across the three child segments.

A human GIS pass against the underlying EIA report PDF (not opened — see P7644/P7645 notes) or the 川气东送二线 皖西支干线 EIA report would likely yield exact station coordinates and could also supply ready-made route geometry given the explicit corridor-reuse relationship to P7613.

Chaining these two facts: this row (P7613, 'Huainan-Bozhou Branch Line', 208.40km, 川气东送二线) is almost certainly the same 皖西支干线 named in both notices, run start-to-end in the reverse direction from P7646 (P7613: Huainan→Bozhou per GEM's own existing StartLocation/EndLocation; P7646: Bozhou→Huainan). The near-identical lengths (208.40km vs 210.80km) further support this — the small delta is consistent with P7646 counting a bit of extra distance for its own tie-in/renovation work at the Fuyang distribution/pigging station (阜阳分输清管站, on this branch) rather than a genuinely different alignment.
